draft.shortGloss: to come; to fall (of rain or snow)
draft.emotion: straightforward and direct, announcing someone's arrival or approach
notes: Unlike English 'come', 오다 is only used for movement toward the speaker's own current or future location. When moving toward the listener ('I'm coming to your place'), Korean uses 가다 (to go).
